cohort_size_policy.allocation_rule: Primary stratification is target class, with at least 3 selected assets per nonempty target class and remaining positions allocated by proportional largest remainder across nonempty target-class x modality-family x development-stage strata. Empty or insufficient strata fail closed rather than triggering outcome-directed substitution.
cohort_size_policy.reason: Fifteen is retained for operational comparability with the prior Batch 5 work unit only; it is not a historical substitute size rule.
cohort_size_policy.replacement_rule_before_freeze: A selected asset may be replaced only for a documented identity, duplicate, eligibility, or source-preservation failure discovered before corpus freeze, using the next candidate from the same predeclared stratum and original deterministic selection order. The replacement requires an immutable replacement record and independent validation. No replacement is permitted because of semantic difficulty, missing/conflicting outcomes, or pipeline performance.

construction_procedure: write immutable universe and complete manifest

cutoffs.post_selection_change_control: Fail closed; no silent cutoff change.
cutoffs.relationship: The selection cutoff controls whether an asset existed and met selection criteria. The evidence cutoff controls which public source versions may be considered later. Any change after candidate selection requires a new cohort version or formal governance amendment.
cutoffs.retrieval_date: Recorded per source at acquisition and may be later than the cutoffs; retrieval date does not change eligibility and cannot expand the evidence boundary.
cutoffs.semantic_review_start_date: Must be recorded in the future review protocol and must occur after corpus freeze and independent corpus validation.

deduplication.ambiguous_rule: AMBIGUOUS or POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE candidates cannot both enter until independently resolved

definition.biosimilar_or_follow_on_handling: Exclude biosimilars, follow-on products, and generic products unless a future amended frame explicitly includes them; they are not silently treated as distinct novel benchmark assets.
definition.combination_therapy_handling: Include a combination only when the CD19/BCMA component is a distinct identifiable therapeutic asset with its own stable identity; otherwise record the combination as a relationship and do not count it as a second product.
definition.development_stage_boundaries: Clinical-stage assets from Phase 1 through Phase 3 and approved or marketed assets with qualifying public development history as of the cohort-selection cutoff; preclinical-only and discovery-only assets are excluded.
definition.duplicate_product_and_lineage_handling: Normalize aliases and corporate lineage before deduplication. One canonical asset record is permitted per distinct therapeutic product/program. Merged, transferred, acquired, renamed, or split programs require explicit stable-lineage documentation; unresolved cases are excluded until independently resolved.
exclusion_criteria: Identity supported only by an ambiguous or unverified alias
Duplicate product or unresolved product lineage
Evidence cannot be retrieved and preserved reproducibly
Asset outside the cutoff or permitted universe
Selection would require semantic, pipeline-performance, or historical-outcome information
definition.geographic_or_regulatory_boundaries: Worldwide sponsors and development programs are eligible when at least one qualifying US, EU, UK, or other governance-approved official or administrative anchor is publicly retrievable.
inclusion_criteria: Target is CD19 or BCMA under the target-class rule
Modality is within the permitted modality boundaries
Development stage is within the permitted stage boundaries
Sponsor or developer is publicly attributable
Canonical identity and stable identifier requirements are satisfied
At least one qualifying official or administrative source is retrievable and preservable
Identity is unique after alias and lineage deduplication
No unresolved merger, transfer, split, or product-lineage ambiguity remains
modality_boundaries: CAR-T and other genetically modified cellular therapies
T-cell engagers and bispecific or multispecific biologics
other therapeutic biologics with a public target and modality identity
definition.multi_target_asset_handling: Include dual-target assets only with explicit official identity support for each declared target; assign a deterministic multi-target stratum and do not duplicate the asset across target strata.
definition.renamed_transferred_acquired_handling: Retain one canonical identity with aliases and dated sponsor/developer lineage when resolvable; exclude unresolved identity splits or mergers.
definition.sponsor_or_developer_eligibility: Commercial, academic, nonprofit, and public-sector sponsors or developers are eligible when the responsible organization is publicly attributable; licensing, partnering, acquisition, or transfer relationships must be documented as identity lineage, not used as an outcome criterion.
definition.target_class: CD19 or BCMA as a declared therapeutic target; dual-target assets are included only when both targets are explicitly anchored by an official source.
definition.terminated_withdrawn_inactive_handling: Include if the asset met the frame and was identifiable by the cutoff, regardless of later termination, withdrawal, or inactivity. Record status neutrally; do not exclude for outcome or difficulty.
definition.therapeutic_area: Human therapeutic assets for hematologic malignancies, including B-cell malignancies and plasma-cell disorders.
definition.time_window_requirements: The asset must meet all inclusion criteria and have existed as an identifiable clinical-stage or approved/marketed program on or before the cohort-selection cutoff.

prohibited_purposes: Filling the missing 15 assets to claim a historical 75-asset result
Recreating guessed versions of opaque historical assets
Selecting assets based on known pipeline successes or failures
scientific_and_operational_purpose: Test the benchmark workflow on a fully reproducible cohort
Establish a current independently verifiable CD19/BCMA benchmark
Replace an unusable experimental scope with a separately versioned cohort
Measure workflow and evidence-governance performance under improved controls
Expand the benchmark family without rewriting historical results

requirements: retain original selection in audit history

permitted_comparisons: Coverage or correctness under clearly separated versions

prohibitions: No new-cohort assets or outcomes in historical denominators
No artifact under historical, recovery, Clean Baseline V1, adjudication, or corrected-derivative paths
No label implying Batch 5 recovery or completion
required_statements: This benchmark uses a newly selected cohort.
It is not Batch 5 Clean Baseline V1.
It does not recover or replace the opaque historical cohort.
It cannot be used to confirm the historical 75-asset profile.
Historical and new-cohort results must be reported separately.
The global historical phase manifest remains invalid.

forbidden_combinations: protocol engineer as sole protocol validator
governance authority relying only on creator counts
release authority relying only on creator claims

selection_methodology.candidate_universe_construction: Build one neutral record per eligible candidate from qualifying public identity sources, apply the predeclared frame, normalize aliases and lineage, deduplicate, and sort by deterministic_order_key.
selection_methodology.exclusion_processing: Apply declared inclusion/exclusion rules before sampling. Late exclusions fail closed unless the replacement rule applies and is independently validated.
selection_methodology.future_selection_order: deterministic_order_key then normalized identity tuple within declared stratum
selection_methodology.method: Deterministic enumeration followed by stratified seeded random sampling.
prohibited_selection_behaviors: Replacing difficult assets with easier assets
Removing assets because they generate missing or conflicting outcomes
Using pipeline outputs to define the sample
selection_methodology.random_algorithm: Python random.Random with the declared SHA-256 seed integer; Python runtime and builder version must be recorded downstream
selection_methodology.replacement_rules: Only pre-freeze identity, duplicate, eligibility, or source-preservation failures may invoke the next predeclared candidate in the same stratum; every replacement is recorded and independently validated.
selection_methodology.rng: SHA-256-derived seed consumed by a pinned, versioned deterministic generator
sampling_script_requirements: Rebuild command and expected deterministic hash
Negative tests for identity, cutoff, duplicate, seed, namespace, and overwrite failures
selection_methodology.selection_seed: Derived exactly from the declared seed-generation method and recorded in the selected-cohort artifact; it may not be changed after universe validation.
selection_methodology.stable_candidate_ordering: deterministic_order_key = SHA256(normalized canonical identity tuple including canonical name, stable identifiers, sponsor/developer, and target class), with the full normalized tuple as a deterministic tie-breaker.
selection_methodology.tie_breaking: Sort by deterministic_order_key, then normalized identity tuple; no manual tie-breaks.

serialization.timestamps: operational metadata only; excluded from deterministic projections

stable_identity.identity_binding: No opaque identifier may be issued without an independently preserved one-to-one binding to the public identity.
required_before_selection: At least one stable official or administrative anchor
No unresolved merger or split ambiguity

stratification.allocation: proportional largest remainder across nonempty target-class x modality-family x development-stage strata
stratification.multi_match: assign one primary target class deterministically; dual-target receives multi-target marker without duplication

unit_of_selection.combination_regimen_rule: Include a combination only when the CD19/BCMA component is a distinct identifiable therapeutic asset with its own stable identity; otherwise record the combination as a relationship and do not count it as a second product.
unit_of_selection.continuity_rule: Retain one canonical identity with aliases and dated sponsor/developer lineage when resolvable; exclude unresolved identity splits or mergers.
unit_of_selection.split_merge_rule: Unresolved split or merge is excluded; resolved continuity is one record; a genuinely distinct product is a separate record with distinct anchors.
unit_of_selection.unit: one distinct therapeutic product/development program with one continuous public identity
